title: Compound unique constraint on account_movements for split tender payments
description: When posting multiple payment allocations for a single sale, using the Sale model as reference_type caused a unique constraint violation on [business_id, reference_type, reference_id, movement_category]. Remediated by referencing individual SalePayment model instances for account movements.
remediation_applied: SaleService now sets reference_type = SalePayment::class and reference_id = $salePayment->id for each payment allocation movement.
